assumptions: Synthetic stage fixtures; not a from-zero purchase progression
Project levels, collection counts, and initial recruit explicitly fixed per fixture
No drinks, no mid-trace equipment changes, same RNG seeds across loadouts
Fixed-ball times use estimateShotTime; 30-minute shots/XP use real settleOfflineGym
Growth uses exported trainPlayer/advanceGym and original template matching; reward probes use real recommend dispatch
Level checkpoints do not guarantee required template; qualified rows check both and stop searching after level 30
Management actions count recruit/cooperation/auto/plan/recommend, excluding synthetic initial purchases and UI navigation
Offline growth stops at its actual configured cap; online growth stops at level 30
Online optimizer horizon is 30 minutes; offline optimizer is a 4-hour absence, credited only to the configured cap, with XP capped at the level-99 requirement
Optimizer exactly enumerates available supply-family combinations under a coupon and slot budget; it does not optimize fame or target-template probabilities
Burst optimization ranks fixed-100-shot elapsed time divided by mean XP; it is a supply proxy, not an exact target-template stopping-time optimum
Cooperation equipment eligibility requires ten equipped shots per qualifying course; every growth kit is worn continuously from shot zero

fullCourseEligibilityRegression.note: Sampled after enforcing 10/10 equipped shots per qualifying course. All main experiments use constant kits from shot zero, so qualification outcomes are invariant.
